settings.purpose: First independent V0-to-V1 baseline comparison; no CacheTide fitting or evaluation
settings.student_state: independent edge; own persistent state within each method; native behavior writes
settings.repair_schedule: prepare once before first history consumer, including behavior append; persist repaired KV
settings.query_only_schedule: original query-only correction on recommendation reads; native behavior writes
settings.cost_population_scope: independent causal 30k event ledger; quality is measured on the separate frozen 512-user development subset
settings.timing_scope: shared-machine execution progress only; no formal timing result

selection: SHA256(seed,uid), only prerelease first behavior and retained role exclusions; no feedback or model gains used
request_rule: known targets; group uid/timestamp/raw item, discard conflicting labels; all feedback in the fixed window
populations: 512 quality users are a frozen subset of the separate 30000-user cost panel; not a joint full-population quality measurement
